description: Explicit primitive aggregate compilation experiment over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. Existing workloads retain their comparison schedules; new queries cover whole-table folds, nullable arguments and FILTER, boolean/bit folds, many groups, and unsupported DISTINCT controls.

workloads.name: aggregate
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE bucket = $1

workloads.name: group
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

workloads.name: aggregate_argument
workloads.sql: SELECT sum((score * 3 + bucket) / (bucket + 1)) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1

workloads.name: aggregate_multi
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*), count(score), min(score), max(score), sum(score), bit_xor(score) FROM items

workloads.name: aggregate_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN bucket = 0 THEN NULL ELSE score END) FILTER (WHERE bucket >= $1), min(CASE WHEN bucket = 0 THEN NULL ELSE score END) FILTER (WHERE bucket >= $1) FROM items

workloads.name: aggregate_bool_bits
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN bool_and(score >= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN bool_or(score > 5000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bit_and(score), bit_or(score), bit_xor(score) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1

workloads.name: aggregate_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT score % 100, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY score % 100 ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: aggregate_distinct
workloads.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT bucket), sum(DISTINCT bucket) FROM items
